resources.string: No chats with unsynced history gaps found.

A gap means part of a chat\'s history isn\'t cached locally yet and will be re-downloaded from Telegram\'s servers when you open that chat. Tap a chat below to open it and start re-downloading its history.
A large chunk of your locally cached chat history disappeared since the last check (%1$d chats affected). Cloud messages aren\'t lost — tap to see which chats and reopen them to re-download.
